title: Everything in Fortnitemares Right Now
caption:
#EpicPartner Everything in Fortnitemares right now: bosses, the Dark Cartridge, Safety in Numbers and more. Use code BAD in the Item Shop.
#Fortnite #Fortnitemares

lines.text: A cursed cartridge is spreading through the Island, corrupting everything it touches.
Step into Battle Royale to see what hair-raising horrors await,
including powerful new weapons, terrifying mechanics, horrifying bosses, and more!

segments.name: Dark Cartridge
segments.sub: Named spot · near the middle of the island

lines.text: It's showtime! Face down animatronic bosses in Battle Royale,
with one always lurking at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Parlor.
Defeat any rogue robot you find to possess the suit and finish the fight Fazbear style.

segments.name: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria
segments.sub: Named spot · northern part of the island

segments.title: Five Nights at Freddy's Bundle · 4,500 V-Bucks on Oct 28

lines.text: Wickedly talented Developers have brought their own horrors to life for Fortnitemares!
Explore a Collection of spine-chilling Islands, each with its own twist.
Face the fear with friends to unlock the Safety in Numbers Quest.

segments.name: Nightmare Neighborhood
segments.sub: Named location · north-west of the centre

lines.text: There are all new Sprites to discover and collect!
Extract and equip them for game-changing Sprite Powers, level them up, and keep growing the Collection in Override.
Sprites will now appear in Ranked too, with abilities disabled to maintain even competition.
